title: Surreal Lotus Eye Staircase
description: A vibrant surreal scene depicts a woman in a flowing blue dress ascending a black spiral staircase adorned with pink lotus flowers. Above her floats a massive pink and yellow lotus containing a detailed blue eye with silhouetted figures inside, projecting beams of light downward onto a crumbling orange architectural structure below.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork of a woman in a blue dress climbing a black spiral staircase wrapped in pink lotus flowers. A giant glowing pink and yellow lotus flower with a realistic blue eye at its center floats in a cracked sky, containing three silhouetted figures. Beams of light shine down from the eye onto ancient crumbling orange ruins below, surrounded by more lotus flowers on dark water, with birds and a small boat in the background.
